VERDICT: The staged repair is correct and fully satisfies all requirements for build-then-run ordering, status propagation, and fresh-checkout execution.
ACTION ITEMS: No changes are required; the implementation correctly isolates the build, prevents CLI execution on failure, and validates exact command sequences.
BUILD CONSEQUENCE: The Release build executes exactly once per runner, ensuring the artifact is available for the subsequent `--no-build` CLI invocation.
FAILURE CONSEQUENCE: Build failures propagate their exact exit codes (31/37) and prevent CLI execution, ensuring no misleading exit markers are generated.
